Provides React UI, routing, state, validation, and chart helpers for validator and slot views.

# Purpose
This code is a bundled front-end library for a transaction and slot analysis user interface. It combines filter controls, search controls, charts, tooltips, summary cards, and slot navigation to display transaction data, bank data, validator data, and slot state data. It builds the UI state and chart data used to show transaction timing, fees, tips, compute units, income, bundle state, error state, and slot progress. The file also exports React components and helper APIs such as `Vl`, `Qre`, `mKe`, `mZe`, `EZe`, and `fZe`, plus utility functions for filtering, ranking, formatting time, and building chart series.
